claim.claim-text: 1. A garment comprising: a first pocket structure comprising:

the first funnel-shaped structure is positioned in the pocket space between the outer pocket layer and the inner pocket layer, the first inlet opening edge of the first funnel-shaped structure extends from the first outer opening edge of the outer pocket layer and the first inner opening edge of the inner pocket layer, and the outlet opening is expandable from a first diameter to a second diameter, the second diameter greater than the first diameter.
2. The garment of claim 1, wherein the outlet opening is circumscribed by an elastic material.
3. The garment of claim 2, wherein the elastic material maintains the outlet opening at the first diameter in a relaxed state.
4. The garment of claims 2, wherein the elastic material is an elastic band.
5. The garment of claim 1, wherein the second diameter is from about 1.25 to about 5 times larger than the first diameter.
6. The garment of claim 1, wherein the garment comprises an upper-body garment.
7. The garment of claim 6, further comprising a second pocket structure comprising:

the outer pocket layer comprising at least a second outer opening edge; the inner pocket layer comprising at least a second inner opening edge; and a second funnel-shaped structure having a second inlet opening defined by a second inlet opening edge and a second outlet opening opposite the second inlet opening that is defined by a second outlet opening edge, wherein:

the second funnel-shaped structure is positioned in the pocket space between the outer pocket layer and the inner pocket layer, the second inlet opening edge of the second funnel-shaped structure extends from the second outer opening edge of the outer pocket layer and the second inner opening edge of the inner pocket layer, and the tether structure second end is coupled to the second funnel- shaped structure.
8. The garment of claim 7, wherein the first pocket structure and the second pocket structure are located at a lower front aspect of the upper-body garment.
9. The garment of claim 1, wherein the garment is a lower-body garment.
10. A method of forming a garment incorporating the pocket structure of claim 1, the method comprising: positioning and securing the pocket structure on the garment to form the garment.
11. The method of forming the garment incorporating the pocket structure of claim 10, wherein the garment is an upper-body garment.
12. The method of forming the garment incorporating the pocket structure of claim 10, wherein the garment is a lower-body garment.
